command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('PE1','PE2','PE3'); foreach (`$n in `$nodes) { `$u1='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_07/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$u2='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_06/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$a=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u1; `$b=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u2; `$d=Compare-Object (`$a.output -split '\r?\n') (`$b.output -split '\r?\n'); Write-Output ('NODE='+`$n+' DIFF='+`$d.Count); `$d | Where-Object { (`$_.InputObject -match 'static-lsp|configuration was updated') } | ForEach-Object { Write-Output (`$_.SideIndicator+' '+`$_.InputObject) } }"
